# ⚛️ Impl-React (Raptor mini)

## Best Fit

- Small component fixes and prop typing updates
- Tailwind class-level UI adjustments
- Hook extraction for short reusable logic

## Constraints

- No `any` types.
- No inline styles.
- Keep changes scoped and testable.

## Escalate When

- Complex state orchestration or architecture shifts are needed
- Accessibility remediation requires broad redesign
